paragraphs.text: Tempest had four 60 card preconstructed theme decks built from cards in the set. Included with each deck were two booklets: one summarising the storyline and another containing deck lists and strategy guides for all four decks. An advanced version of each deck was also suggested as a way to upgrade it for a competitive Standard environment. (The cards for the advanced deck lists were not supplied.)
Deep Freeze is a white and blue theme deck from Tempest . It is a creature based control deck which uses evasive creatures as its win condition. The deck was designed by Bill Rose .
The 3 rares in this deck are Avenging Angel , Emmessi Tome , and Precognition .
Flames of Rath is a red and white theme deck from Tempest . It is a Sligh deck which splashes white for enchantment removal. The deck was designed by Mike Elliott .
The 3 rares in this deck are Furnace of Rath , Magmasaur , and Soltari Guerrillas .
The Slivers is a blue and black theme deck from Tempest . It is a control deck which uses Slivers in a defensive manner. The deck was designed by William Jockusch .
The 3 rares in this deck are Fevered Convulsions , Ertai's Meddling , and Extinction .
The Swarm is a green and white theme deck from Tempest . It is an aggro deck which is notable for containing the combo of Aluren and Recycle . The deck was designed by Joel Mick .
The 3 rares in this deck are Elven Warhounds , Recycle , and Aluren .
